description: New Proposed Overcurrent Relay Coordination for Microgrid Protection is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yendry Gonzalez, Arturo Conde (Universidad Autonoma de Nuevo Leon). These data are complementary to the paper: " New Proposed Overcurrent Relay Coordinationfor Microgrid Protection"The paper presents a protection of microgrids (MGs) through a proposed coordination of directional overcurrent relays (DOCRs). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
